## Critical gaps: what Domestika does not publicly disclose

The following information was systematically searched across all official domestika.org pages (teachers page, terms of service, privacy policy, help center, plus page, affiliates page, forums, FAQ) and **is not publicly disclosed anywhere**:

- **Teacher commission percentage or revenue share split** — no percentage or formula appears on any official page
- **Advance fee amounts** paid to teachers upon course creation — not mentioned
- **Royalty rate or formula** — not mentioned
- **Minimum withdrawal/payout threshold** for teachers — not mentioned
- **Payment schedule for teachers** (frequency, timing) — not mentioned beyond "you'll receive payments"
- **Teacher tiers or differentiated plans** — no tier system described publicly
- **Who sets the course price** — Terms say Domestika can change fees; no mention of teacher input on pricing
- **How refunds affect teacher payments** — not addressed in any public document
